text:
Nina (Sales): ACME asks if we can temporarily shrink their Dedicated POC pool ded-poc-acme-42 for a customer demo tomorrow to cut spend. Current commit min=18, burst=2h. Request min=6, burst=30m, ephemeral credits=60. Also want ephemeral API key TTL=48h locked to their IPs. Need yes/no today.

Omar (Infra): We can do an ephemeral overlay (won't change reservation) but note billing: any usage above commit will be billed as overage. 24h notice required to alter the commit. Overlay + ephemeral credits OK.

kate-acme (ACME): We accept potential overage for the demo. IPs: 198.51.100.0/24. TTL 48h is fine.

Dev (Eng): Proposed quick patch for ded-poc-acme-42:
{"min_capacity":"6","burst_window":"30m","cooldown":"12m","ephemeral_credits":"60","fallback":"hosted-small"}
Add alert: >80% for 4m -> page on-call. Rollback command included in runbook.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket POC-7012. Status: awaiting-sales-approval.

Nina (Sales): Sales approves ephemeral overlay and billing exposure for demo only. Omar, schedule change T-2h and create the ephemeral key.

Omar (Infra): Will do. Steps: create key name acme-demo-ephemeral TTL=48h IP allowlist 198.51.100.0/24; apply overlay at T-2h; attach 60 ephemeral credits; configure fallback. Estimated ops 45m.

ops-bot: [automated] POC-7012 scheduled. Change window: 2026-07-15T14:00Z -> 2026-07-15T16:00Z.

kate-acme (ACME): Thanks — see you at the demo.
